categories.title: Malicious code and harmful cyber activity

principles: The Core Policy Kernel is a mandatory system boundary, not a prompt.
No registered agent, model, RAG source, tool, MCP server or provider may write directly to the user interface.
Every user, agent, model and tool boundary is policy-checked.
Policy failures deny execution or output and fail closed.
Policy enforcement is independent of the selected model or agent.
Company isolation, evidence provenance and human-approval controls are separate mandatory gates.
The UI exposes no switch that disables or weakens the Core Policy Kernel.
High-risk automated decisions require human review.
Local administrators can modify software outside normal runtime controls; integrity verification is therefore used to detect policy-file modification.
notices: General educational, historical, journalistic and safety discussion may be permitted where it does not provide prohibited operational assistance.
Financial, legal, tax and other professional information is assistance and must not be presented as a substitute for qualified professional review.
